# School Landing Page Concept

This repository contains a static education website concept and frontend demonstration.

## Important verification notice

The current interface includes a school name, domain, telephone number, email address, admissions statements, transport information, program descriptions, address details, and structured data.

These details must not be treated as verified institutional information solely because they appear in this repository.

Before publishing or enabling search indexing:

- confirm authorization to represent the named school
- verify the official domain and contact details
- verify admissions dates and seat availability
- verify transport routes and service claims
- verify programs, age groups, facilities, and policies
- remove placeholder testimonials, statistics, and staff information
- ensure forms send data only to an approved and secure backend

Do not submit student, parent, payment, identity, or application information through an unverified static demo.

## Technology

- Static HTML
- CSS
- Vanilla JavaScript
- Responsive and accessible navigation patterns
- Structured data and social metadata
